description: Reads up to 50 files by name from head, published, or an explicit version. A single-file read supports line and character ranges; continue truncated reads with `nextStartCharacter` and the resolved `version`.

endCharacter.description: Last character to return from the selected line range (1-based, inclusive). Only valid when reading a single file.

endLine.description: Last line to return (1-based, inclusive). Only valid when reading a single file.

names.description: File names to read (up to 50). Singleton files are addressed by their type name, for example `global_css`.

startCharacter.description: First character to return from the selected line range (1-based, inclusive). Only valid when reading a single file.

startLine.description: First line to return (1-based, inclusive). Only valid when reading a single file.

version.description: Explicit source version. Takes precedence over `target`.

name: websiteSourceCode_files_read
title: Read source files
